business_meaning: Surrogate key for the dimension row (surrogate join key used by facts)
documented_rules: Surrogate key (primary key) for the dimension row; used as join key to facts.
inferred_rules: Must be unique; not null; used by fact tables as FK; increments per new dimension row.
Unique per account version; identifies the business account across SCD2 versions; natural key may repeat across versions but one current row must exist.

business_meaning: Identifier of the customer who owns the account
inferred_rules: Links account to the owning customer; must be populated for every account row.

business_meaning: Code for the savings product (product type)
documented_rules: Allowed example values: EASY_ACCESS, FIXED_1Y, NOTICE_90, ISA.
inferred_rules: If ProductCode = 'FIXED_1Y' then AccountMaturityDate must be populated; otherwise AccountMaturityDate should be NULL.

documented_rules: Allowed values: OPEN, CLOSED, DORMANT, FROZEN.
inferred_rules: If AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' then AccountCloseDate must be populated; otherwise AccountCloseDate should be NULL.

documented_rules: Currency is ISO 3-letter code; documented dataset uses GBP as the currency.
inferred_rules: Currency should be a valid ISO3 currency code (e.g. 'GBP'); for this domain expect 'GBP' for all rows.

AccountOpenDate must be <= AccountMaturityDate when AccountMaturityDate is populated; should be <= AccountCloseDate when AccountCloseDate is populated; should not be in the future relative to load date.

documented_rules: AccountMaturityDate is mandatory when ProductCode = FIXED_1Y; nullable for non-term products.
inferred_rules: When populated, AccountMaturityDate must be after AccountOpenDate; when ProductCode != 'FIXED_1Y' it should be NULL.

documented_rules: AccountCloseDate must be populated when AccountStatus = CLOSED.
inferred_rules: When populated, AccountCloseDate must be >= AccountOpenDate; if AccountStatus != 'CLOSED' then AccountCloseDate should be NULL; closed accounts should not be marked IsCurrent = 1 unless historical handling requires it.

business_meaning: SCD2 start date for this dimension row
documented_rules: ValidFrom is the SCD2 start date for the dimension row.
inferred_rules: ValidFrom must be <= ValidTo; current row typically has ValidTo = '9999-12-31'; exactly one row per natural key should have IsCurrent = 1 and ValidTo = '9999-12-31'.

business_meaning: SCD2 end date for this dimension row
documented_rules: ValidTo is the SCD2 end date for the dimension row; current rows use 9999-12-31.
inferred_rules: ValidTo must be > ValidFrom; current row uses ValidTo = '9999-12-31'; SCD2 ranges for a natural key must not overlap.

documented_rules: IsCurrent flags the active SCD2 row (1 = current version).
inferred_rules: Exactly one version per natural key should have IsCurrent = 1; IsCurrent = 1 should correspond to ValidTo = '9999-12-31'.
